question: Let $x,y,z$ be real numbers. Then only one of the following statements is true. Which one is it?

options.A: If $x<y$, then $xz<yz$ for all values of $z$
options.B: If $x<y$, then $\frac{x}{z}<\frac{y}{z}$ for all values of $z$
options.C: If $x<y$, then $(x+z)<(y+z)$ for all values of $z$
options.D: If $0<x<y$, then $xz<yz$ for all values of $z

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
